source_basis: TAV-05S fixed-line geometry + ETABS insertion-point capability
notes: No auxiliary structural column joints on the 30x110 support solely to force beam convergence
A beam that is horizontal/vertical in the source remains horizontal/vertical analytically
Use per-frame endpoint offsets from the column fixed-line joint to the documented/projected attachment axis
Transform stiffness for offsets from section centroid when applying the insertion-point assignment
Do not connect a beam geometrically to the fixed-line joint by rotating its analytical axis
Joint/insertion offsets define axis eccentricity; end-length offsets, if later used, model clear-length/rigid-zone effects and are not substitutes
